title: Document repo using standardized header comments and generate machine-readable map
task_summary: Scan the entire repository to add a descriptive three-part header to all hand-authored code/config files, and generate a machine-readable JSON map of the repository structure with Raw GitHub URLs.

files_changed.change: Created script to automatically write standardized 3-part headers to all 209 hand-authored files.
Created script to walk repository, extract summaries, and output docs/map.json with Raw GitHub URLs on development branch.
Added CI step to verify that docs/map.json is up-to-date and fails if there is a diff.
Generated repository map containing path, raw_url, and description for every non-excluded hand-authored file.

assumptions_verified.verification: Confirmed scripts/generate_headers.py walked and updated all 209 matching code/config files.

assumptions_verified.assumption: raw url format complies with spec
assumptions_verified.verification: Confirmed docs/map.json contains raw URLs with dynamically resolved owner/repo and development branch.

decisions.decision: Use development branch for raw URLs in maps
decisions.reasoning: Using the development branch prevents CI check failures when merging features to development, since the merge build runs on development.

self_review.checked: Header syntaxes, JSON validation, Raw URL schemas, CI diff validation
changes_made: Hardcoded development branch name inside generate_map.py's URL builder to prevent CI regressions on detached HEAD or custom feature branch checks.

notes_for_next_step: Step 17 is fully complete. All hand-authored files are fully documented and map.json is automatically verified in CI.
